cues.text: People don't miss bills because they're careless.
They miss them because bills arrive as email.
Deadline Bill Guard turns a forwarded invoice into a payable bill.
Then makes sure you never pay a late fee again.
One click opens the demo with twelve bills, five subscriptions, and thirty days of history already loaded.
This is the one screen that answers what's due, and what's late.
And how much recurring spend is quietly leaving every month.
Four reminders are scheduled for every bill.
The subscription radar totals the plans you forgot you were paying for.
Now the part that does the work: the inbox.
Forward an invoice, or paste it.
A classifier decides if it's really a bill.
Then an extractor pulls the merchant, amount, currency, due date, and invoice number.
Promotions are ignored.
Anything under sixty percent confidence goes to a human review queue, never silently into your bills.
Every field is validated with Zod, cross-checked by a deterministic parser, and scored for confidence.
You can audit the source email.
The reminder ladder is scheduled automatically.
Seven, three, one, and zero days before the due date.
PayPal isn't bolted on.
Orders v2 creates the order with the bill id.
The payer approves, and the return handler captures the payment.
A verified webhook reconciles the capture.
Every order, capture, and event lands in the bill's audit trail.
Subscriptions group themselves.
The plans you never use become a yearly number you can act on.
Everything exports to CSV.
No bank logins, no scraping.
The inbox you already use is the source of truth.
Deadline Bill Guard.
Forward a bill, get reminded, pay with PayPal.
Source and setup are on GitHub.
